note: What a stage subagent needs — and nothing else. Context that grows monotonically across a run is paid on every turn that follows: by K3 the agent would otherwise still be carrying K0's brief, the skeleton, every token file and every screenshot. Each stage runs in a fresh context with the packet built from this spec, and returns its artifact plus a short summary. `dops handoff <stage>` is the packet.

K0.job: Turn the request into product + experience.primary_job. Lite (quick): three lines from the request, <=1 clarifying question, no competitor analysis. Full (standard/full): JTBD audience, >=3 neutralised competitor skeletons, positioning frames, content inventory.

K1.job: Produce the information model and the NEUTRAL skeleton: real copy, grey graphite, data-priority, not_approved_visual_design marker. App profile fills domain_model, roles_permissions, user_flows, screen_modules, state_matrix, api_contract BEFORE screens. No taste questions, no visual decisions [A.3].

K2A.job: Apply the profile's base skin (skins/base-site or skins/base-app): compile tokens, apply, zero taste questions, zero gate. The product becomes presentable and testable.

K2B.job: Calibration -> 2-3 constructed-divergence directions -> two-screen slice + blind contact sheet -> Gate 2 -> merge -> DTCG tokens -> scale. Never touches structure [A.7].

K3.job: Run the floor as ONE command, read failures[], fix trivial mechanical issues, route substance back with exact values, write the quality report and the verdict. Never judge taste.
K3.acceptance: python3 tools/dops_verify.py --profile standard && python3 tools/dops_hash.py check
do_not_read: raw screenshots beyond the shot manifest

deliver.job: Plain-language summary: what was built, what the gates decided, what was verified, the measured cost against the estimate, what remains.
outputs: the final message to the user
